name: Sea All Dolphin Swims
summary: Sea All Dolphin Swims runs boat trips from Queenscliff Harbour into the southern end of Port Phillip Bay. Guests snorkel with Australian fur seals and wild dolphins, or stay on deck to watch them. The business has operated since 1996 and takes all ages and swimming levels.
standouts: Certified Green Leader with Ecotourism Australia
Recognised as one of Tourism Australia's Sustainable Storytellers
Every ticket includes a $10 environmental levy supporting Southern Ocean Environmental Link (SOEL)

contact.address: Shop 3. Building 6, Queenscliff Boat Harbour, Queenscliff VIC 3225

trips.title: Seal & Dolphin Swim on Maureen
trips.summary: A half-day trip on the boat Maureen into the southern end of Port Phillip Bay. It usually starts with a snorkel at Pope's Eye, then a swim with Australian fur seals at Chinaman's Hat, then a search for wild dolphins. Guests who prefer to stay dry can join as sightseers.
highlights: Snorkel at Pope's Eye in the Port Phillip Heads Marine National Park
Swim with Australian fur seals at Chinaman's Hat
Swim with wild dolphins under strict approach rules
Roof jumps, boom net, duck spa and rope ride included
trips.season: Twice daily during the warmer months

prices.label: Family pass (2 adults, 2 kids), Seal & Dolphin Swim
Family pass (1 adult, 2 kids), Seal & Dolphin Swim
Family pass (2 adults, 3 kids), Seal & Dolphin Swim

includes: 5mm wetsuit, snorkelling mask and flippers
Optional adventure activities: roof jumps, boom net ride, duck spa and rope ride
Light refreshments and drinks (hot drinks and soft drinks) on Maureen
Wind proof and waterproof jacket for sightseers
Marine grade toilet on board Maureen
$10 environmental levy per person supporting SOEL
trips.requirements: No minimum or maximum age. Adults need some prior swimming experience; anyone who rates themselves below 5 out of 10 must book a personal instructor. Children with low swimming ability must be accompanied by a competent adult. Minimum of 6 participants for the tour to run on Maureen. Maureen carries up to 25 swimmers.
trips.checkNotes: Departure times conflict on the same page: the Departure Time box says 8:30 AM or 1:00 PM, but the Local Tip text says the afternoon tour is at 1:30 pm. Used the Departure Time box. Infant price conflicts: rates list Child (0-4) $30, the FAQ says under-5s who do not swim are $25. priceFrom is the Sightseeing Adult fare ($120); the adult snorkel fare is $220. Season wording is only 'twice daily during the warmer months', no dates given. The page also lists private charter rates (Morning $4,000, Afternoon $4,400, Twilight $3,000), recorded under Private Charters. GoPro underwater camera hire is mentioned with no price.

trips.title: Wildlife Sightseeing Tours on Maureen or Bluebird
trips.summary: A 90-minute wildlife cruise in the southern part of Port Phillip Bay with no swimming. Guests look for fur seals, three kinds of dolphin, little penguins and seabirds, and humpback and southern right whales in winter. The crew picks the boat and route to suit the day's weather.
highlights: Australian fur seals at their haul-out sites
Burrunan, bottlenose and short-beaked common dolphins
Humpback and southern right whales during the winter migration
Stays dry, suits families and short visits
includes: Expert crew interpretation
Wind proof and waterproof jacket for sightseers
$10 environmental levy per person supporting SOEL
trips.requirements: All ages. Vessel (Maureen M or Bluebird) is chosen on the day to suit the weather.
trips.checkNotes: Page says 'Departing 12:00PM Daily' but gives no season dates. Infant price is $30 here; the FAQ says $25 for under-5 non-swimmers.

trips.title: Seal + Dolphin Swim Island Hopping on Bluebird
trips.summary: A small-group seal and dolphin swim on Bluebird, limited to 8 guests. The low, shallow boat reaches quieter parts of the bay such as Mud Islands and Nepean Bay. The extra time and care suit private groups, guests with special needs and weaker swimmers.
highlights: Small groups limited to 8 guests
Visits Mud Islands and Nepean Bay
Snorkel with Australian fur seals and dolphins
Extra flotation available if required
includes: 5mm wetsuit, snorkelling mask and flippers
Extra flotation if required
$10 environmental levy per person supporting SOEL

Children with low swimming ability must be accompanied by a competent adult. Minimum of 3 participants on Bluebird. No toilet on Bluebird.
trips.checkNotes: The page's Book Here button goes to the same Rezdy product as the Maureen Seal & Dolphin Swim (320091), not a separate Bluebird product. Optional GoPro underwater camera hire mentioned with no price. No season stated.

trips.title: Twilight Tour on Maureen M.
trips.summary: An evening trip on Maureen in summer, timed for sunset over the southern part of Port Phillip Bay. Guests can snorkel with Australian fur seals or stay on deck to watch seals and seabirds at dusk. Dolphins are not the focus but can turn up.
highlights: Sunset on Port Phillip Bay
Snorkel or sightsee with Australian fur seals
Seabirds at dusk
Roof jumps, boom net, duck spa and rope ride included

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Private boat hire from Queenscliff Harbour on either Maureen M or the smaller Bluebird, planned around the group. Options include seal snorkels, dolphin watching, sightseeing at Mud Islands, South Channel Fort and Nepean Bay, transfers to the Portsea Pub and ash scatterings. Trips run from 90 minutes to a full day.

trips.title: Corporate Tours
trips.summary: Private team days and client events on Maureen M or Bluebird. Groups can snorkel with seals and dolphins, sightsee around Mud Islands, South Channel Fort or Nepean Bay, and add hands-on conservation sessions such as plastic recycling or harbour waste removal. The crew can help pair the trip with meeting rooms and catering ashore.

trips.title: Stingray Bay Queenscliff Harbour – Snorkel or Scuba Experience
trips.summary: A shore-based snorkel or scuba session in a fenced, sheltered section of Queenscliff Harbour where large smooth stingrays pass. SSI instructors guide all levels, and submerged platforms and ramps make entry easy. If no rays are seen, guests can come back within 7 days for free.
highlights: Smooth stingrays in a fenced harbour site
Guided by SSI instructors, beginner to advanced
Stingray guarantee: free repeat within 7 days if no rays are seen
Optional night dives

trips.summary: A fully private seal and dolphin swim for school groups, with a full snorkelling lesson and marine ecology talk. Students meet Australian fur seals and Burrunan dolphins and visit several snorkel sites chosen for the day's conditions. Risk assessments, insurance papers and curriculum-linked outcomes are provided.
